meta_description:
19K likes, 56 comments - harman_fitness_mommy on September 20, 2026: "Baby zai’s first visit to Harmandir sahib ✨ 

And Guess what she said muma yeh apka naam hai and for the first time in my life I realized my full name is in Harmandir sahib 🥹

She had to be born for me to find this out … I can’t believe no one ever said that to me and I never thought of it either . 

Coming back my Nani would jokingly always say you will stay in every heart that you meet “ har man vice raheye gi “ now when I think of it I actually did make a place is so many unknown hearts the love n blessings me , puneet and the kids have received over the years through our work makes my heart so full . 

I hope i continue to receive this love and blessings from you all and my actual big boss 🫡

#darbarsahib #waheguru #amritsar #goldentemple blessed".
